title: Measured exact witness counts and unary rank selection
claims: Under the bounded sparse truth-table reduction hypothesis, exact witness counts can be computed in unary when accepted witness sets have polynomial cardinality.
Under the same reduction hypothesis, a unary-indexed selector returns the exact zero-based lexicographic rank or explicit out-of-range failure.
The measured enumerator returns the exact sorted distinct prefix of accepted witnesses.
The directed measured boundary pruner preserves every sparse-consistent last-true candidate.
The exact unconditional inclusion P subset NP checks independently.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned exact-statement checker when the reference checkout is available and otherwise report unavailability.
